.claude/skills/bdg.description: Use bdg CLI to drive and debug a real Chrome via Chrome DevTools Protocol - navigate, click, fill and submit forms, check what an action changed (navigation, new messages, pending requests), inspect elements without screenshots (box, layout, fonts, colors, a11y), read network requests and console errors, run JavaScript, and call any CDP method. Use this skill when you need to verify a UI change in a running app, debug a page, automate a browser flow, or scrape dynamic content.
